title: SynBullying: A Multi-LLM Synthetic Conversational Dataset for Cyberbullying Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distributions of cyberbullying types, harm intensity, participant roles, and conversational structures in LLM-generated synthetic data against an authentic human-annotated baseline dataset.

Evaluating how safety-aligned models (like GPT-4o) systematically deviate from realistic data by over-generating supportive roles, artificially inflating positive sentiment, and under-representing aggressive online interactions.
